knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dust bags alone do not capture fine dust efficiently. On-tool extraction connected to a collector is needed (WorkSafe Victoria, read 2026-11-02).
Compressed air can re-suspend settled dust. Use a HEPA-filtered vacuum or a wet method.
Tight-fitting respirators need clean shaving and a fit check each time. Stubble and a loose mask fail the control.

practicalCriteria: On-tool extraction connected to a collector at the required dust class before sanding starts
No compressed air used for clean-up; HEPA-vacuum or wet method used instead
Respirator fit check recorded, with shaving where a tight-fitting type is used
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Dust control record with collector dust class
stopWorkCriteria: Compressed air used to clean sanding areas
Respirator used without a fit check
